This section contains projects highlighting my skills in data and statistical analysis

## Projects

__Project 1__: [Rich Distributing](Consulting.Rmd)

For this project, I worked with a first aid company in Utah, Shield Safety, on a consulting project for their subsidiary company, Rich Distributing. I performed a linear regression to determine whether buying a new tablet machine would increase their productivity and profits.

__Project 2__: [Music Education](Semester_Project_Template.qmd)

In this analysis, I looked at data on private music lessons and performed linear regression, t-test, and ANOVA statistical tests to determine what factors go into making a lesson more effective.
